decisions.rationale: Microcephaly is a named, specific malformation with a single definition, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
Mental retardation is a grey-area term that covers a family of heterogeneous conditions rather than one specific disease, so it is a Disease Class.
Short stature is a descriptive clinical finding and not a named disease entity, so it is not annotated.
Cohen syndrome is used here as a noun modifier of 'region' (a Cohen syndrome region on 8q), so it is annotated as a Modifier.
'Clinical entity' is a general term for a concept and does not name a disease, so it is excluded.
'Syndrome' is a very general term that is excluded when used without a specific disease name.
This is a repeated mention of microcephaly in the abstract; duplicate mentions are each annotated, and it is a Specific Disease.
'Progressive postnatal growth deficiency' is a descriptive phenotype built on the general term 'deficiency' and does not name a specific disease.
This is a repeated mention of mental retardation, a grey-area term that refers to a class of conditions, so it is a Disease Class.
Hypotonia is a clinical sign or symptom (reduced muscle tone), not a disease name, so it is not annotated.
Chorioretinal dystrophy refers to a family of retinal and choroidal dystrophies rather than one specific disease, so it is a Disease Class.
Myopia is a single, well-defined refractive eye condition with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease.
'Condition' is a very general term referring to the patients' state and is excluded.
Repeated mention of mental retardation as a grey-area term referring to a class of conditions, so it is a Disease Class.
Short stature is a descriptive clinical finding and not a named disease entity, so it is not annotated.
Cohen syndrome is a named, specific disease here (the initially considered clinical diagnosis), so it is a Specific Disease.
'Genetic entity' is a general term for a novel concept and does not name a disease, so it is excluded.
Cohen syndrome is named as a specific disease (the gene region refined for Cohen syndrome), so it is a Specific Disease.
